I implemented `clamp` as `max(lo, min(x, hi))` in `bounds.py`. Two of the three tests pass, but `tests/test_regressions.py::test_issue_212` can't pass.

That test expects `clamp(5, 0, 10) == 10`. `tests/test_clamp.py::test_inside` expects `clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5` for the same call, and the requested behavior (limit `x` to [lo, hi]) also gives 5. No implementation can satisfy both without special-casing that input, which would break the function.

I left the test alone. It looks wrong or stale, so please check what issue 212 intended. If the expected value should be 5, fixing the test makes the whole suite pass.
